features.Pure Tones: The Deepest One ignores the Disoriented condition while standing on or submerged in solid stone.
features.Swim Through Stone: The Deepest One can move through solid surfaces as if moving along the ground, ignoring difficult terrain. While fully submerged, the Deepest One must spend 1 focus each time they use an action other than the Move action or their Regenerate free action. The Deepest One can’t use this feature on surfaces made of wood.
features.Merging Form: Before the Deepest One takes impact or keen damage from a non-wooden source, they can spend 1 focus to increase their deflect value to 6 against that damage (no action required).

Strike: Trip Attack.Description: Deepest One can knock the target Prone

Grasping Hands.Saving Throw: DC 17 Agility test or become Restrained.
Grasping Hands.Description: If the Restrained target is also Prone, they begin suffocating and are Afflicted [2d10 vital]. The Restrained character can use 2 actions to make a DC 17 Agility test, removing the Restrained condition on a success. If the Deepest One takes at least 20 damage on a single turn, the target escapes and is no longer Restrained.

Surge of Cohesion.Saving Throw: DC 15 Agility or Athletics test to avoid conditions.
Surge of Cohesion.Description: The chosen object or area changes shape in a manner they choose, though not violently enough to cause damage.

Regenerate.Description: The Deepest One recovers 5 (1d6 + 2) health. They can use this free action even while Unconscious or otherwise prevented from using actions.

Entrap.Description: When an enemy triggers a Reactive Strike from the Deepest One while the Deepest One is submerged, the Deepest One can instead use their Grasping Hands as a Reaction, spending focus as if they made a Reactive Strike.
